analysis: The t03 recipe is conv, depth 3, width 64, layernorm, gelu, gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95, cells reward, bonus 5 and step penalty 0.01. It reaches about 0.995 at lr 0.001, with three runs at 0.994, 0.998 and 0.994. Higher lr (0.0015–0.003) reaches 1.0 on some seeds but collapses on others, at 0.85–0.93. Ent 0.002, width 128, a step penalty of 0.05 and rollout 32 all hurt. Depth 4 is no better. The hidden test retrains with new seeds, so seed robustness matters more than peak score. I'll probe lower lr and other stabilisers around lr 0.001.

proposals.hypothesis: Lower lr 0.0007 with the t03 recipe should lower seed-collapse risk and keep ~0.995 success. Refuted if dev success is below 0.99.
Clip_eps 0.1 at lr 0.0015 limits the policy step size, which may keep the fast learning of higher lr while avoiding collapse. Refuted if dev success is below 0.99.
8 minibatches at lr 0.001 gives more, smaller-batch updates at the same sample cost and may close the last failures. Refuted if dev success is not above 0.995.
Noise check of the t03 config at lr 0.001 with a new seed, to pin down the robust recipe's mean. Refuted if dev success is below 0.98.
